results.overview: The entertainment industry’s most competitive reality stars and famous faces play the ultimate murder mystery game. Hosted by award-winning actor Alan Cumming at an ancient castle set deep in the Scottish Highlands, contestants work together on a series of exhilarating missions to build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. Hidden amongst the Faithful are the Traitors, whose goal is to eliminate the Faithful and claim the prize for themselves.
results.name: The Traitors

results.overview: Deception, lies and betrayal are the name of the game, as four Traitors infiltrate a group of 24 players and use their skills to eradicate 'loyal' contestants trying to win $250,000 in silver bars.
results.name: The Traitors

results.overview: Strangers play the ultimate game of detection, backstabbing and trust in the hope of winning up to £120,000. But hidden amongst the players are three Traitors, who secretly ‘murder’ a player every night. It’s up to the Faithfuls to banish them from the game before they become the next victim. If the Faithfuls eliminate all the Traitors they split the cash; but if a Traitor remains undetected to the end of the game, they take all the money.
results.name: The Traitors

results.overview: Welcome to The Traitors — a ruthless reality show hosted by the enigmatic Karan Johar. Here 20 players will openly betray each other in daily eliminations to compete for a grand prize . Hidden amongst the innocent players are the traitors who are out to murder each night. In this ruthless game, trust is rare and betrayal everywhere.
results.name: The Traitors

results.overview: In The Traitors, 16 celebrities meet in a French castle. This is where a psychological strategy game begins, because three of the prominent players are traitors who can eliminate fellow players in each round or be unmasked themselves. The question remains: Will the loyal players manage to banish the traitors from the game and share the profits? Or will one traitor succeed in deceiving everyone until the end and pocket the winnings for himself alone?
results.name: The Traitors

results.overview: An all-star cast play the ultimate game of deceit and betrayal.
results.name: The Celebrity Traitors

results.overview: In a magnificent castle, personalities will take part in an experience they will never forget. A game of lies, manipulation, and betrayal, hosted by Éric Antoine, where anything goes. Among the players, some will be designated as traitors, while the others will be loyal. Day and night, the traitors must lie about their true identity, devise strategies to deceive the loyal players, and secure their place in the game. To achieve this, they must win challenges, withstand psychological pressure, outwit strategies, and mislead their enemies. Most importantly, they must avoid elimination to be the last one standing and win the game!
results.name: The Traitors France

results.overview: Follow a group of contestants – including some familiar faces – who live together as they complete a series of challenges with the goal of earning a cash prize. The catch? Some of the contestants are traitors who will attempt to deceive and manipulate their way to the prize instead of sharing it amongst the group. In this psychological adventure will the traitors be unmasked in time?
results.name: The Traitors Canada

results.overview: Catch up from the castle. The latest banished and murdered have their say with Ed Gamble. How will they react to the betrayals, revelations, mind games and manipulations?
results.name: The Traitors: Uncloaked

results.overview: Deception, lies and betrayal are the name of the game as players descend on a luxury lodge, isolated from the hustle and bustle of everyday life for the chance to win a cash prize. A devilish little game with one main goal – find and unmask the traitors, the secret saboteurs within the group, before they take out the Faithful one by one.
results.name: The Traitors NZ

results.overview: The murdered, the banished and the Traitors themselves reveal insights into the strategic gameplay and psychological warfare that led to each victim's ultimate demise.
results.name: The Traitors Postmortem

results.overview: 22 strangers are pitted against each other in a remote castle, where they must play a game an imaginative game of strategy. The twist? Some players, known as the Traitors, are secretly tasked with eliminating their competitors each night without being detected.
results.name: The Traitors Ireland

results.overview: An adaptation of the global hit The Traitors. In this Ukrainian reality show, 22 contestants compete for half a million hryvnias. Among them are “faithfuls” and “traitors.” The faithfuls must expose the traitors, while the traitors aim to survive to the finale. The action unfolds at the Shenborn Castle.
results.name: The Traitors

results.overview: Twenty well-known figures set off for the mysterious castle of The Traitors Türkiye. A cryptic game of wits, full of surprises, awaits them. While they work together by day to grow the prize money in their communal vault, betrayal reveals itself by night. As the Traitors 'execute' the Faithful each night, the Faithful attempt to uncover the Traitors at the Round Table.
results.name: The Traitors Türkiye

results.overview: Set at an ancient castle set deep in the Scottish Highlands, everyday Americans work together on a series of exhilarating missions to build a prize fund worth up to $250,000. Hidden amongst the Faithful are the Traitors, whose goal is to eliminate the Faithful and claim the prize for themselves. Under the cover of darkness, the Traitors murder the Faithful one by one in a treacherous spree while the Faithful try to uncover the Traitors and banish them from the game. If the Faithful contestants banish all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund, but if a Traitor (or Traitors) makes it to the end, they will steal all the money.
results.name: The Traitors: New Blood

results.overview: Exciting murder mystery game where participants are put to tough psychological tests to figure out who the traitors are. Tip: Don't trust anyone!
results.name: The Traitors Sweden

results.overview: Fourteen players gather in a castle to compete for a grand prize by completing a series of missions. But among them hide the traitors - secretly eliminating their fellow contestants one by one. The rest are the faithful, and it's up to them to identify and banish the traitors before they become the next victims.
results.name: The Traitors - Italy
